simple.meaning: מִשְׁמָע (Mishmâʻ) is a Hebrew word meaning “Mishma , the name of a son of Ishmael, and of an Israelite.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מִשְׁמָע (H4927) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 25:14, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִשְׁמָע (H4927) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מִשְׁמָע (H4927) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מִשְׁמָע (Mishmâʻ) / H4927 is traced through Genesis 25:14, 1 Chronicles 1:30, 1 Chronicles 4:25, 1 Chronicles 4:26 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
